metrics.name: merchandise value
metrics.definition: Sum order_items.price once per item line in BRL. Exclude freight and payments. Apply delivered status only when requested.

metrics.name: delivered merchandise value
metrics.definition: Join order_items to orders on order_id and filter order_status = 'delivered'. Sum price once per line.

metrics.name: customer
metrics.definition: customer_id is an order-specific record. Count distinct customer_unique_id for people. For repeats group orders by customer_unique_id.

metrics.name: freight
metrics.definition: Use item-level freight_value for freight in BRL.

metrics.name: payment
metrics.definition: Analyze payment_type and payment_value at payment grain. Never sum payments after joining to item lines.

metrics.name: purchase date
metrics.definition: Use order_purchase_timestamp for order placement. Approval, carrier handoff, customer delivery and estimated delivery are separate dates.

metrics.name: delayed deliveries
metrics.definition: Compare order_delivered_customer_date to order_estimated_delivery_date for delivered orders.

metrics.name: geolocation
metrics.definition: ZIP prefixes repeat. Never join geolocation directly to aggregate counts or amounts.

metrics.name: English category
metrics.definition: Use a left join on product_category_name to retain untranslated categories. Ask for clarification if this lookup is unavailable.
